title: tier-2 shipped code: texture popcount helper against FUN_142e374d0 (0x142e374d0)
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-tank/src/texture.rs, built by cargo and called by crates/ow-tank/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the texture_count_bits_shifted entry.
Oracle is FUN_142e374d0 at exe 0x142e374d0 (v2b 0x7ff7c7b574d0). It returns uint in EAX; arguments are uint value (ECX) and char bias (DL).

The function popcounts value >> ((bias + 2) & 31). The loader calls it with bias 1 (0x142e376d0(DAT_143a7c390), DAT_143a7c390 = 1), which is the shift-3 popcount behind TextureHeader::streamed_chunks. The fixture pins every shift for dense and one-hot values and the signed-char bias wrap.

knownEquivalentMutants.rationale: The mutation widens the shift mask from 0x1f to 0x3f. Both the oracle (0x142e374d0) and the candidate run on x86-64 release, where a 32-bit shift masks the count to 5 bits: (bias + 2) & 0x3f produces counts 32..63 that the hardware shifts by count & 31, which is exactly (bias + 2) & 0x1f. The two builds therefore return the same value for every u32 value and every bias. What would observe a difference: a target that traps or saturates a shift count of 32..63 instead of masking it, which is outside this unit's x86-64 ABI contract.
